# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Our pledge

We pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behaviour that helps:

- Being kind and respectful to other people
- Respecting different opinions, viewpoints and experiences
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- Owning our mistakes and learning from them

Examples of unacceptable behaviour:

- Sexualised language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing other people's private information without their explicit permission
- Other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Scope

This code applies in all project spaces (issues, pull requests, discussions) and when someone officially represents the project elsewhere.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through [GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/David-Rodden/diablo2-browser/security/advisories/new) or by contacting [@David-Rodden](https://github.com/David-Rodden). Every report is reviewed promptly and kept confidential.

The maintainer may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues and other contributions that break this code, and may ban anyone temporarily or permanently for behaviour they consider inappropriate.
